newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Klima sees Austria 97 deficit at 2.7 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Klima sees Austria 97 deficit at 2.7 pct of GDP.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima said on Tuesday Austria's federal budget deficit was planned to fall to 68 billion schillings, or 2.7 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 1997.
Last year, Austria's deficit was at 89.4 billion schillings, or 3.7 percent of GDP, he added.
"Our aim for 1997 is to cut the budget deficit to 68 billion schillings," Klima told a news conference. "It seems possible."
A deficit of 2.7 percent of GDP would put Austria well within the Maastricht criteria for membership in Europe's planned single currency, scheduled to start in 1999. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
